results.evidence: With timeutil.utc_now pinned to 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z (Denver date 2026-11-30), main(['report','--period','7d']) and '30d' return EXIT_OK. Their stdout contains the exact lines 'Period: 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-30 (America/Denver)' and 'Period: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30 (America/Denver)'. tests/test_report_period.py pins utc_now and asserts both lines (test_period_header_7d and test_period_header_30d). The _report helper asserts the exit code is 0. events.denver_today derives from timeutil.utc_now, so the pin takes effect. All 23 tests in test_report_period.py passed. I ran the tests but did not invoke the CLI by hand.

test_from_to_boundaries_follow_denver_dates logs missed_call events through the real log-event CLI at 06:59:59Z (counted), 07:00:00Z (excluded), 06:00:00Z on Nov 1 (included) and 05:59:59Z on Nov 1 (excluded). It asserts the report shows 1, then 2. The same file's test_start_boundary_alone checks the start boundary on its own. All 23 tests in tests/test_report_period.py pass. I did not run the report CLI by hand outside the tests.

I ran `uv run cottonwood report --config config/pilot.yaml <flags> --out <file>` for all 7 cases. Each exited 1 with stderr starting 'error:', wrote nothing to stdout, and did not create the --out file. Messages: both --period and --from/--to -> 'give either --period or --from and --to, not both'; --from alone and --to alone -> '--from and --to must be given together'; no flags -> 'give --period 7d|30d, or --from and --to (YYYY-MM-DD)'; 2026-1-5 -> 'expects YYYY-MM-DD'; 2026-02-30 -> 'is not a valid date'; reversed range -> '--from 2026-11-15 is later than --to 2026-11-01'. In cottonwood/cli.py, the period is parsed and the config loaded before any file write. Both errors print 'error: ...' and return EXIT_REFUSED.

results.evidence: I ran the commands against a freshly migrated DB with config/pilot.yaml. Without --out: exit 0 and the first stdout line is '# Weekly report'. With --out into the two missing dirs x/y: exit 0, stdout 'report written: /tmp/claude-501/p/x/y/r.md', the directories and file were created, and cmp showed the file identical to the earlier stdout. Missing DB path: exit 1, stderr 'error: database does not exist: ... (run `cottonwood migrate` first)'. Empty unmigrated file: exit 1, stderr 'error: could not read the database: no such table: activities'. Neither error output contained 'Traceback'. The code in cli.py _run_report matches: mkdir(parents=True), write_text, print 'report written: ', and error handlers return EXIT_REFUSED. I did not run the repo's test files.

_inbound counts non-test inbound_inquiry leads (is_test = 0) per channel (form, phone), per segment (commercial, residential, unknown) and a total, and skips any lead whose Denver received date is outside the period. Counters start at 0 for every channel and segment, so an empty database prints 0 everywhere. tests/test_report_inbound.py passes 16/16. test_inquiries_by_channel_and_segment covers a test inquiry and one received 2026-10-31, before the 11-01 start, and neither is counted. test_empty_database_prints_every_inbound_line_as_zero covers the empty case. I did not run the report command by hand.

ack_deadline (report.py:83-91) returns the received date on a working day, otherwise the next Monday-Friday date. _inbound (report.py:116-146) takes each lead's earliest counted (non-voided) acknowledgement, ordered by occurred_at then id (events.py:353). It counts within when the Denver ack date is on or before the deadline, outside when it is later, and not acknowledged when there is no counted ack. The lines at report.py:196-198 always print all three counts. tests/test_report_inbound.py covers every AC case: Fri->Fri within, Fri->Sat outside, Sat 11-28->Mon 11-30 within, Sat 11-21->Tue 11-24 outside, voided-only not acknowledged, earliest of two decides, and the empty database prints zeros. 39 tests in the two report test files passed.

report.py computes missed_calls and returned_calls as len(_counted_in_period(...)) for the types missed_call and call_returned. _counted_in_period uses events.counted_activities, whose COUNTED_ACTIVITIES_SQL excludes voided events and events on is_test leads. test_missed_and_returned_calls covers voided events, test-lead events and an out-of-period event. test_empty_database_prints_every_inbound_line_as_zero covers both labels at 0. All 39 tests in tests/test_report_inbound.py and tests/test_report_period.py pass.
